# sitemap commands

Every `sitemap` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `sitemap:generate`

Generate sitemap.xml from all registered providers

```bash
bin/semitexa sitemap:generate
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--output` | yes |
| `--base-url` | yes |
